summary: FAIL -- Phase 5 BLOCKED. Executed ONLY Phase 5 of plans/02_birelational-pivot.md (canonical-frame incestuality verification), per explicit dispatch scope -- STOPPED before Phase 6, which was NOT started. Phase 5's literal goal -- prove cs5Incest (@cs5CanonMreach Atom), i.e. that the canonical model (CS5CanonSegment, Phase 3) SATISFIES the ≤-mediated incestuality condition -- is MATHEMATICALLY FALSE, not merely hard to prove. Direct analysis: boxInv is monotone under ⊆, so cs5Incest's witness u' >= u can never help satisfy boxInv u'.head ⊆ w.head if boxInv u.head already fails to fit inside w.head (any problematic □C persists into any extension, and w.head is untouched by the choice of u'). This collapses the ≤-mediated goal to PLAIN (unmediated) symmetry of cs5CanonMreach -- exactly the naive two-sided condition Marin Remark 7.3 and this pivot's whole design says is wrong intuitionistically. Concrete counterexample: the exploding world (head = Set.univ) is cs5CanonMreach-reachable from EVERY canonical world (boxInv _ ⊆ Set.univ trivially), but cannot route back to any non-exploding world (its head is already maximal, so the only candidate witness is itself, forcing boxInv Set.univ = Set.univ ⊆ P.head, i.e. P.head = Set.univ). Mechanized this fully and rigorously in CS5Canonical.lean rather than forcing the false theorem through or leaving a sorry: cs5CanonMreach_to_univ (universal reachability of the exploding world), cs5Incest_cs5CanonMreach_forces_univ (if cs5Incest held, every canonical world would be exploding), cs5_consistent_incest (CS5 is consistent -- bot underivable, via a one-point model reusing Phase 4's landed cs5_soundness_derivable_incest/cs5FCIncest UNCHANGED), and cs5Incest_cs5CanonMreach_false (the outright contradiction). All four theorems are sorry-free with lean_verify axioms subset of [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], no warnings. This is explicitly NOT a rediscovery of the Phase 1 negation-completeness wall (grep-confirmed: zero negation-completeness moves anywhere in the counterexample proof) -- it is a distinct, new, purely set-theoretic obstruction specific to the UNRESTRICTED CS5CanonSegment world type landed in Phase 3 (no invariant excludes the degenerate universal-successor exploding world). Two candidate unblock paths identified, both requiring a new planning round with explicit human authorization: (1) restrict CS5CanonSegment with a hereditary invariant excluding the degenerate case, precedent CS4Segment's excl/excl_head fields (task 508); (2) weaken cs5Incest to an existential/disjunctive clause handling the exploding case specially, precedent cs4FC''s existential weakening of blanket transitivity (task 508). Neither was attempted in this dispatch since both are significant design decisions (~100-250 lines) outside Phase 5's scope and this dispatch's hard constraint against reworking Phase 4's landed cs5FCIncest without approval.

blockers.why_stuck: CS5CanonSegment (Phase 3) pins every world's tail to the UNRESTRICTED maximal tail {t | QuasiPrime t ∧ boxInv head ⊆ t}, with no invariant excluding degenerate heads. The exploding world Omega (head = Set.univ, quasi-prime via quasiPrime_univ) is reachable from every P, but Omega's head is already maximal so no witness other than itself is available, and boxInv Set.univ = Set.univ forces P.head = Set.univ for any P it would need to reach back to -- false for consistent (non-exploding) P, and CS5 is consistent (mechanized via a one-point model).
